What is the opportunity?

As the Marketing Coordinator within the Wealth Marketing Canada (WMC) web team, you will be the go-to executor for advisor website requests across the country. You will support the web team by actioning website change requests from investment advisors and their teams, managing the WMC marketing general inbox, supporting website audits and ensuring every page meets RBC compliance and formatting standards. Must-have

• A task-oriented, execution-focused mindset — you take ownership of your queue and find satisfaction in getting things done.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a service-oriented approach to working with advisors and internal partners.

• Attention to detail and a careful eye for formatting, consistency, and brand standards.

• Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and follow established processes while knowing when to escalate.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint) or equivalent tools.

• A self-starter who thrives in a hybrid work environment and is comfortable collaborating virtually and in person.

Nice-to-have

• Experience in the financial services industry, particularly within wealth management.

• Familiarity with SEO best practices and tools (e.g., Google Search Console, keyword research tools).
